info.title: WebhookRelay
info.description: Reliable event delivery: at-least-once delivery with retries and a dead-letter queue, idempotent ingestion and HMAC-signed webhooks (Standard Webhooks). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`: source keys publish events, admin keys manage subscriptions and deliveries.

get.summary: Readiness: 200 when the database answers, 503 otherwise

post.description: 202 when the event is new and has been fanned out; 200 when the same id was already received (rule D1).

id.description: Event id in the source system; repeated ids are ignored (idempotency key).

post.description: For webhooks, the response includes the signing secret. It is shown only this once.

patch.summary: Activate, deactivate, rename, retarget or change event types

post.description: The previous secret keeps signing for 24 hours, so the receiver can switch without losing events.

get.description: Filter with status=dead to see the dead-letter queue. Paginate with `cursor`.

get.summary: Attempt history of a delivery, oldest first

post.description: Only deliveries in the dead state; the retry budget starts over (rule D6).

tags.name: deliveries
tags.description: Delivery status, attempts and replay (admin keys)
